## Description

Proposed topology-aware approach to cross-sectional stock ranking: Score stocks relative to one another using model features, then use the ranks to form a portfolio; the target variable, universe, rebalance frequency, and long/short rules need definition. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
